product_goal: Help an employee orient, plan, perform, verify, and learn from daily work using one reviewed knowledge spine and role-bounded agents.

layers.name: Case authority and employee scope
layers.purpose: Bind the goal, role, data class, permissions, risks, done conditions, reviewer, and stop rules before retrieval.

layers.name: Reviewed knowledge and source spine
layers.purpose: Resolve current, stale, superseded, private, generated, and prohibited sources without turning connectivity into authority.

layers.name: Bounded context perception
layers.purpose: Combine stable CAG, LlamaIndex retrieval, optional TurboVec candidate results, structural evidence, and exact reads into one compact source-visible capsule.

layers.name: Adaptive role crew
layers.purpose: Select the smallest responsible role set and give each role only its goal, context projection, allowed skills, tools, output, reviewer, and handoff.

layers.name: Specialist research and delivery
layers.purpose: Create evidence-linked requirements, research, tasks, copy, outreach, designs, implementations, reports, or onboarding answers without expanding authority.

layers.name: Graph control, validation, and review
layers.purpose: Use LangGraph state, reducers, checkpoints, interrupts, repair routes, requirement validation, deterministic checks, and independent review to control what may advance.

layers.name: Receipts, outcomes, and maintained knowledge
layers.purpose: Record exact results and readback, measure onboarding/work outcomes, and promote only reviewed reusable meaning with lineage and freshness.

wikillm.job: Portable durable reviewed memory: indexes, memory, insights, runs, issues, decisions, and append-only log.

obsidian.job: Optional local human knowledge workspace for semantic notes, maps, sources, and review queues.
obsidian.authority: human-readable projection governed by the same promotion rules
obsidian.security: Community plugins are privileged local code and require trust, pinning, review, backup, and restricted-mode fallback.

llamaindex.job: Allowlisted ingestion, document/node metadata, retrieval routing, filters, ranking, and source-node return.

turbovec.job: Optional compact local vector candidate behind the LlamaIndex vector-store adapter; it accelerates candidate selection but never compresses away authority, citations, or exact source reads.
turbovec.known_limit: no native LlamaIndex MMR or native hybrid mode after full-precision vectors are discarded

orbit_and_graphify.job: Generated code/file structure, definitions, references, paths, and likely impact for exact-source follow-up.
orbit_and_graphify.orbit: optional private local code adapter with one clean allowlisted corpus and freshness checks
orbit_and_graphify.graphify: generated repository relationship reference queried before broad structural reads

crewai.job: Express role, goal, task, tool, knowledge-source, expected-output, delegation, and handoff contracts for the selected crew.
crewai.authority: none beyond each injected role contract

langgraph.job: Own case state, conditional routes, bounded parallel branches, reducers, checkpoints, interrupts, repair loops, and terminal states.

checkpointer.local_single_user: SQLite after approval and migration proof
checkpointer.team_runtime: PostgreSQL after tenancy, backup, and recovery proof

langgraph.idempotency: all side effects occur after interrupt and use action_id replay protection

dashboard.job: Primary non-technical case, task, knowledge, crew, review, receipt, and configuration projection.
dashboard.jarvis: embedded contextual operator guidance, not a separate brain or authority

sections.content: rules, authority, project identity, source boundary
role goal, inputs, outputs, tools, forbidden actions, reviewer
retrieved nodes plus exact source excerpts and structural entry points
relevant verified outcomes, repairs, and supersession
unknowns, stale items, owner questions, stop triggers

perception_capsule.compression_rule: Compress summaries, never provenance. Every material claim retains source_ref, authority_state, observed_at, review_by, and exact-read status.

research_methods.use: Grade primary/current/reviewed versus secondary/historical/unverified evidence before synthesis.
Keep observation, reasoning, testable belief, and missing evidence distinct.
Require independent support and actively search for counter-evidence for material claims.
Define the situation, progress sought, trigger, current alternative, push, pull, habit, and anxiety.
Trace symptom to mechanism and decision impact without treating a public signal as confirmed pain.
Translate a target outcome into observable milestones, responsibilities, and evidence.
Separate universe, company fit, person-role currentness, trigger evidence, and demand proof.
Attach source, status, owner, freshness, counter-evidence, and allowed use to each public claim.
Convert evidence into versioned requirements, non-goals, exceptions, and objective acceptance/readback checks.
Freeze the maker candidate, review independently, repair through the maker, and verify the exact result.

skill_spectre.job: Static skill package risk inspection before allowlisting.
skill_spectre.current_evidence: low-risk static scans recorded for two ArchFlow skills
skill_spectre.rule: A clean static result is one input to review, never automatic installation or trust.

video_spectre_pattern.job: Reuse the inspection pattern—inventory, isolate, scan, normalize, fixture-test, compare, approve, and roll back—for media or large generated-skill packs.
video_spectre_pattern.rule: Do not claim a named scanner executed unless a public receipt records it.

dashboard_sections.label: Today
dashboard_sections.job: Show the employee mission, role, evidence boundary, reviewer, next action, guidance, phases, and first-thirty-minute path.

dashboard_sections.label: Work
dashboard_sections.job: Orient one case and drive its research or specialist mission through evidence, requirements, maker, review, stop condition, and readback.

dashboard_sections.label: Knowledge
dashboard_sections.job: Inspect source classes, retrieval route, freshness, gaps, and exact-source requirements.

dashboard_sections.label: Team
dashboard_sections.job: Inspect all roles, selected workflow packs, responsibilities, methods, skills, prohibitions, reviewer routes, and handoffs.

dashboard_sections.label: Review
dashboard_sections.job: Trace evidence, requirement versions, validator results, independent decisions, repairs, approval interrupts, receipts, readback, and promotion.

dashboard_sections.label: Set up
dashboard_sections.job: Configure and export portable source, retrieval, role, state, checkpointer, and loopback-bridge proposals without activating them.
